subject.title: Agents: default nodes describe to current node

question: Should omitted-node `nodes` `describe` calls resolve through the existing default-node picker, return node-list discovery data, or remain invalid with a stricter model-facing schema?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but the linked issue discussion presents multiple valid model-facing semantics and the PR chooses the multi-node-sensitive default-node behavior.

options.title: Confirm Default-Node Describe
options.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only lookup through the existing default-node picker, then require focused regression coverage and redacted after-fix proof before merge.

options.title: Use Discovery Output
options.body: Replace the PR shape so omitted-node `describe` returns list-style discovery data and avoids implicit target selection in multi-node setups.

options.title: Require Explicit Node
options.body: Keep `describe` target-specific and update the model-facing schema or prompt contract so agents know `node` is required.

recommendation.title: Confirm Default-Node Describe
recommendation.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only lookup through the existing default-node picker, then require focused regression coverage and redacted after-fix proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history connection to the split nodes tool schema and default-node resolver path involved in the choice.
